discardCards.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

ice.title: Triggerman
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.
